ARCC.basis_en: // ===== ARCC (reviewed 2026-11-25). Source: Arabian Cement Co (Egypt) consolidated condensed interim statements 9M2026, ARABIC scanned (foudalens 2026-11-12_297525_1.pdf), read visually pp.3-5 (limited review, Deloitte, dated 11 Nov 2026, unmodified conclusion) and notes 9, 26, 27, 29. Every figure checked by arithmetic (gross = sales - cost; pre-tax - tax = profit; parent + NCI = profit; equity = assets - liabilities). Cash (4,258.7m) is DERIVED from current-asset total minus other current lines because the cash digits were not clean on the scan. EPS printed 8.06; my division of the note-9 figures gives 8.07 (parent profit 3,035.9 less the 0.36% employee share = 3,025.0, / 374.867m shares = 8.07; the printed 8.06 leaves a 0.01 gap, unconfirmed). Dividing the parent profit BEFORE the employee share gives 8.10, which is not comparable to the printed EPS. FV profit EXCLUDES other income 491.9m (of which only 139.8m is explained: export-support collected in Q2, note 29; 352m not explained) and FX gain 60.8m: pre-tax 3,972.1 - 491.9 - 60.8 = 3,419.3, taxed at the 9M effective rate 23.57% = 2,613.6m, less the employee share ratio 0.36% = 2,604.2m. That adjusted profit, the tax rate and the ratio are my computation (implied). No second news source found (searches returned the Saudi company of the same name). EGP million. Analyst data: not fetched.

Checks done: assets 30,444.9 = equity 6,406.6 + liabilities 24,038.3; gross = 24,356.3 - 21,874.0 = 2,482.4; pre-tax 1,871.9 - tax 492.7 = 1,379.2; parent 1,155.2 + NCI 224.0 = 1,379.2; EPS 0.847 = 1,145.7 / 1,352.35m shares. FV profit = 9M profit after the 5% legal reserve (3.3m) and 10% employee/board share (6.2m) per note 6.B = 1,145.7m. Shares 1,352.3538m (note 7, nominal 0.5). Q3-only parent profit 577.3m (about half the 9M) means the 9M-annualised range is likely conservative; the Q3 run-rate EPS ~1.69 is my computation (577.3 x 4 x 0.9918 / 1,352.35), not printed. Net finance income 378.8m (interest on large cash and T-bills) is recurring but rate-dependent. FX was a small loss (28.3m), nothing stripped. EGP million. Analyst data and news not checked.

SCEM.basis_en: // ===== SCEM (reviewed 2026-11-25). Source: Sinai Cement separate interim statements 9M2026, English (foudalens 2026-11-16_297899_1.pdf, read visually pp.3-5), limited review conclusion unmodified (dated 15 Nov 2026). The company has only an affiliate investment of 25.0m (no subsidiaries shown), so separate statements are the full picture. EPS printed 10.75 = 2,804.6m / 260.81m shares (paid-in capital 2,608.1m at par 10; no employee share deducted in the note). FV profit EXCLUDES FX gains: 9M pre-tax 3,692.0m minus FX gain 398.7m = 3,293.3m, taxed at the 9M effective rate 24.03% (887.3m / 3,692.0m) = 2,501.8m. That ex-FX profit and the tax rate on it are implied (my computation, not printed). EGP million. Analyst data: not fetched. No second news source checked.

EXPA.basis_en: // ===== EXPA (reviewed 2026-11-25). Source: Export Development Bank of Egypt (EBank) consolidated interim statements 9M2026, English translation (foudalens 2026-11-12_297503_4.pdf; balance sheet p.1, income statement p.2, review report p.2 unmodified, Forvis Mazars + Accountability State Authority) and separate statements (2026-11-12_297497_4.pdf, note 13 EPS). EGP million. // KEY FACTS: (1) 9M consolidated profit to shareholders 4,827.8 (+12.1% vs 4,305.1) but includes "Profit from financial investments" of 3,195.8 (9M25: 86.6); only 16.2 of it in Q3, so it is H1. Q3 shareholders' profit 933.7 vs 1,661.2 (-44%). (2) Capital: 13.6bn to 18.0bn bonus shares (note 36, listed 7 Oct 2026), so shares now 1,800m (feed agrees); separate EPS printed 2.98 uses 1,360m shares (pre-bonus). (3) Consolidated EPS/deductions are not in the consolidated notes I read: I applied the SEPARATE note-13 deductions ratio (fund 46.7 + board 93.1 + staff 465.3 = 605.0 = 13.0% of separate profit) to the consolidated figure: IMPLIED, unconfirmed. (4) The tax effect on the 3.2bn gain (38.4% = the 9M effective rate) is an ASSUMPTION. "Revenue" = sum of net interest, net fees, dividends, trading, investment gains and other operating (my definition). Analyst data not fetched.

ANOMALY: the auditors' conclusion text in the file is dated "Cairo, 28 April 2026", before the period end: probably a template date error in the filing, not confirmed. Equity comparative is 31 Dec 2025 (23,630.4m). Analyst data not fetched.

Valmore has two share lines (ir.valmore.com/en/share-and-corporate-information): VLMR, the USD line, and VLMRA, the EGP line, and the two trade at different levels, not at an FX ratio. The app keeps VLMRA (page price 25.9 EGP, P/B 1.18 on BVPS 21.94 EGP, P/E about 6.5 on adjusted full-year EPS 4.00 EGP); VLMR was removed from the app on 28 Nov 2026. The earlier UNCONFIRMED line reconciliation is settled by the company's IR page.
